contract.title: TWIN-46 921600全栈配置化启动与MC/TH Debug↔Web UI双向链路对账集成验证
contract.accepted_scope: Software and sim-mode full-stack integration verification of debug_reconciliation_probe.py across the 5 telemetry/control categories (temperature, motion/homing, bed-leveling grid, filament/slot, job state), mismatch/CRC/drop/offline detection and recovery, and deploy_twin.sh sim-mode lifecycle. Cross-compiler ELF build and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are not applicable: qa-sandbox:20261029 provides host GCC/Python only and no physical MCU hardware; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 消费TWIN-43 AP/VMware 921600串口支持与deploy_twin.sh全栈一键编译及配置化启动脚本
消费TWIN-44 MC固件USART2 921600与USART1非阻塞[MC-DBG]日志固件产物
消费TWIN-45 TH固件USART3非阻塞[TH-DBG]日志固件产物

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；对账工具自检与全栈集成验证；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件

positive_cases: debug_reconciliation_probe.py同步解析[MC-DBG]与[TH-DBG]结构化串口日志流及AP HTTP/SSE状态快照（支持--self-test、--mc-log/--th-log/--ap-snapshot离线对账及--ap-url在线拉取运行中ui-gateway快照与SSE流），自动生成五类核心业务（温度、归零/移动、5x5调平网格、进退丝/料槽、打印作业状态）双向对账报告(--matrix-out)
全栈一键启动脚本deploy_twin.sh在921600默认配置下完成编译、sim模式启动、健康探活、在线双向对账校验与优雅停止闭环
negative_cases: 当[MC-DBG]/[TH-DBG]日志中的五类业务状态与AP/UI状态快照不一致、或出现未预期的CRC_ERR/TIMEOUT/BAD_FRAME/TX_ERR或drop>0/trunc>0时，debug_reconciliation_probe.py返回非0退出码并定位失配项；恢复一致快照与正常日志流后重新对账返回0
当处于业务串口断连/离线状态（system_status=OFFLINE且温度为哨兵值2147483646/32767）时，debug_reconciliation_probe.py校验断连哨兵值与ui-gateway控制接口HTTP 503锁定响应，并在恢复ONLINE快照后对账恢复通过
